items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal of window permit
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (and, absent a separately stated posting date, the posting day) is Thursday 19.11.2026. Per § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V, a letter sent by ordinary mail is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days after the posting day: 20.11. (day1, Fri), 21.11. (day2, Sat), 22.11. (day3, Sun), 23.11. (day4, Mon) -> deemed delivery = Monday 23.11.2026. This is a general municipal authority, not a tax office, so even though the 4th day happened to land on a working day here, no weekend/holiday shift of the delivery day would apply in any case. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §§ 187, 188 BGB from the event (delivery) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23 December 2026 is a normal working day in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday), so no further shift is needed.
